name: safar
description: Sistem Informasi Manajemen Travel Haji & Umrah — PT Safar Barokah Wisata

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('backend/public',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend/public',{recursive:true});console.log('frontend/dist -> backend/public')"
